name: 系统与软件进程管理 (System & Process)
description: 提供启动与关闭软件、读写剪贴板、检测系统运行状态、高精度延时等待与电脑关机休眠等功能

ClipboardValue.description: 读取系统剪贴板中的文字内容，或将新文字写入剪贴板

ExecuteCommand.description: 同步运行 CMD / PowerShell / Shell 命令行脚本并高精度捕获输出字符串与退出代码

ExistProcess.description: 检查指定的应用程序或进程当前是否正在系统后台运行

GetEnv.description: 获取当前进程、用户或系统级的环境变量数值

GetProcesses.description: Retrieve list of running system processes with optional name or path wildcard filter

GetSystemInfo.description: 获取计算机 CPU 核心数、内存可用空间、主机名及操作系统版本等指标

KillProcess.description: Terminate OS processes by PID, name, or path pattern, with support for force termination and process tree kill

LaunchFile.description: 使用操作系统默认关联程序打开指定的文档、表格、图片或脚本

ManageLocalUser.description: Manage OS local user accounts: supports checking existence, adding new users, and deleting users

ManageRegistry.description: Manage Windows registry: supports reading values, writing values, deleting keys/values, and checking existence

ManageService.description: Manage system services: supports querying status, starting, stopping, and restarting services

OpenUrl.description: 使用操作系统默认浏览器打开指定的网页网址 URL

SetEnv.description: 设置当前进程、用户或系统级的环境变量数值

StartProcess.description: Start process with options including no-window, UAC elevation, and user credentials

SuspendSystem.description: 控制计算机进入睡眠、休眠、锁屏、重启或关机状态

WaitForProcess.description: Wait synchronously for a target process to start or exit with customizable timeout
